description: A web-based platform where users can create blogs, post articles, add comments, and like content.
vision: To provide a user-friendly blogging solution that enables individuals to share their thoughts and ideas with the world while engaging in meaningful discussions through comments and likes.

features.name: User Registration & Authentication
features.description: Allow users to register, log in, and manage their accounts.

features.name: Blog Creation & Management
features.description: Enable registered users to create and edit blogs with titles, descriptions, categories, tags, and images.

features.name: Article Posting & Editing
features.description: Provide functionality for blog authors to add new articles to their blogs with rich text support, formatting options, and image uploads.

features.name: Commenting System
features.description: Implement a comment section where users can post comments on articles with the ability to reply to specific comments and delete their own comments.

features.name: Liking System
features.description: Enable users to like articles, which will be displayed as a count on the article page. Likes should be stored and can be removed.

features.name: User Dashboard
features.description: Provide users with a dashboard to view their blogs, articles, comments, and likes. Users should also be able to delete or edit their content from this interface.

features.name: User Profile
features.description: Allow users to create and manage their profiles, including profile pictures, bio, and links to social media accounts.

user_stories.i_want: to create a new blog with my own title and description, so that I can start sharing my thoughts.
user_stories.so_that: I want to be able to manage the content on this platform.
acceptance_criteria: A user can register for an account
A user can create a new blog
The blog has a unique title and description

user_stories.i_want: to leave a comment on an article, so that I can engage in discussions with other users.
user_stories.so_that: I want to contribute to the community and get feedback from others.
acceptance_criteria: A user can view comments on an article
A user can post a new comment
Comments can be replied to by other users

user_stories.i_want: to browse articles, so that I can discover interesting content.
user_stories.so_that: I want to find topics of interest and engage with the community.
acceptance_criteria: A user can view a list of blogs
A user can click on a blog title to read its articles

user_stories.i_want: to like an article, so that I can show support for content that resonates with me.
user_stories.so_that: I want to help authors gauge the popularity of their posts and engage more actively in discussions.
acceptance_criteria: A user can click a 'like' button on an article
The number of likes is displayed next to each article

non_functional_requirements.performance: The system should handle up to 500 simultaneous users without significant degradation in performance.
non_functional_requirements.security: User data must be securely stored, and all transactions (like, comment) should be logged for audit purposes. The platform should also prevent common security vulnerabilities such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting.
non_functional_requirements.scalability: The system should allow for easy addition of more resources to handle increased load without significant downtime or performance loss.
non_functional_requirements.availability: The platform must be available 99% of the time, with minimal scheduled downtimes.

constraints: Design should be responsive and mobile-friendly
assumptions: Existing users will have a way to migrate their data from previous platforms if needed
